sources.excerpt: He began warfarin 5 mg by mouth daily on 01-Aug-2026 for atrial fibrillation and acetaminophen 650 mg by mouth every six hours on 02-Aug-2026.
Warfarin is suspect; acetaminophen is concomitant.
Warfarin was stopped and the symptoms resolved.
On 08-Aug-2026 he developed epistaxis and easy bruising.
No other relevant medical history applies.
